blockers: generated_code_performance, generated_code_memory_efficiency, generated_code_compile_performance, source_token_efficiency, total_token_efficiency lack dedicated runtime-benchmark and tokenizer-accounting instrumentation in this run; values above are qualitative estimates from available compile-time evidence, not measured runtime/memory profiles or exact token counts.

formulas.correct_at_n: all 18 trials eventually pass gate within repair budget = 100
formulas.diagnosis_efficiency: 5/5 failing trials passed on first repair = 100
formulas.generated_code_compile_performance: go build completed quickly (<1s) for all compiling trials; qualitative = 85
formulas.generated_code_performance: not independently benchmarked for runtime speed in this unit; qualitative placeholder based on idiomatic Go generation = 70
formulas.prompt_robustness: min over 3 variants of first-attempt correctness: canonical=83.3, scenario-first=66.7, contract-first=66.7; min=66.7
formulas.repair_success_rate: 5/5 failing trials reached gate on repair = 100
formulas.silent_bug_resistance: 0 silent-bug trials among 13 eligible compiled first completions = 100
formulas.source_token_efficiency: estimated qualitative mid-range score (raw token counts recorded in trials/*/completion_*.txt; no separate tokenizer accounting instrumented in this run) = 65
formulas.specification_compliance: approximated by first-attempt correctness given absence of spec-deviation diagnostics = 72.2
formulas.syntax_hallucination_resistance: first-attempt compile-clean rate (no package-decl / fence hallucination) = 72.2; failures were literal 'expected package' errors from leading stray tokens
formulas.total_token_efficiency: same basis as source_token_efficiency given repair overhead observed (5 trials required 1 extra repair round each) = 65
formulas.unseen_case_generalization: first-completion hidden-case-consistent pass rate approximated by first-attempt gate pass rate = 72.2 (no public_failures observed on compiled trials)
